# PerchTV 0.1.17

The television now says it is loading when you cast to it.

## WHAT CHANGED

- When you send something from your phone, the television shows "Loading…" and the name of what you sent until the picture starts. It used to show the waiting screen for up to fifteen seconds, which looked as if nothing had arrived.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing, casting, play/pause and stop, the skip keys (10 s back, 30 s forward, hold for two minutes a second), the waiting screen that moves and goes dark, the connection check every 45 seconds, and the update check on every start.
